sources.title: Abu Dhabi ranks third globally in AI cities index, TAMM named world’s best AI city app
sources.excerpt:
Abu Dhabi has been ranked the world’s third-best AI city, while its government services platform TAMM has been named the world’s best AI City App in Counterpoint Research’s 2026 Global AI Cities Index.
 The emirate climbed from eighth place last year, strengthening its ambition to become the world’s first AI-native government by 2027.
 The top three cities were separated by just 1.4 points. Singapore led with 65.9 points, followed by Seoul with 64.9 and Abu Dhabi with 64.5, out of 100.
